about: docs/LOOP_PROTOCOL.md 8.1: scripted sessions, the bytes each side sends. Written by firmware/tools/loopxfer.py vectors; don't edit by hand.

sessions.name: hello
sessions.about: HELLO, then the listing: BANK, SLOT and NAME of every slot, STATUS

sessions.name: bad
sessions.about: BAD: unknown OPs, arguments missing or extra, out of range; not remembered

sessions.name: write
sessions.about: A write of a stereo loop with beats and a name into an empty slot; the listing after it

sessions.name: write-replace
sessions.about: A write onto a filled slot: EXISTS without REPLACE, with it the old file replaced; a mono loop; HELLO forgets the request remembered

sessions.name: write-refusals
sessions.about: WRITE_BEGIN's refusals: NOT_A_SLOT, EXISTS, TOO_LONG, BAD, NO_SPACE

sessions.name: write-end
sessions.about: WRITE_END: NO_TRANSFER for another TID, INCOMPLETE before every byte, BAD_CRC (the temp file deleted, repeated: BAD_CRC again), ABORT after it

sessions.name: chunks
sessions.about: CHUNKs lost, repeated and cut off: the gap and its DROPS, the rewind, the stale CHUNKs behind it, a repeat acked, the ring full, a LEN that doesn't match

sessions.name: lost-answers
sessions.about: A lost answer and its repeat across a STATUS poll; a lost ack made good by STATUS; a passing refusal not remembered

sessions.name: pauses
sessions.about: A write paused by a recording, a load and a save, its acks while paused and the OK ack as each ends; a remount meanwhile (a failed save's) loses nothing

sessions.name: timeout
sessions.about: No CHUNK for 30 s: TIMED_OUT, its ack, the temp file deleted; paused time doesn't count; USB gone ends a write (ABORTED)

sessions.name: refusals
sessions.about: The common refusals in their order: NO_CARD, CARD_LENT, BUSY_RECORDING, BUSY_LOADING, BUSY_SCANNING, BUSY_JOB, BUSY_CARD; read-only commands answered in every state; lending ends a write (CARD_LENT)

sessions.name: moves
sessions.about: RENAME, SWAP, DELETE and their refusals; the slots after each, the names going with the files

sessions.name: copy
sessions.about: COPY of TAPE's cubbis, in /TAPE, into FRIZZ slots, and its refusals

sessions.name: copy-root
sessions.about: Stock TAPE's cubbis in the card's root (no /TAPE): STATUS says so, COPY reads them there

sessions.name: bad-wav
sessions.about: Written files FRIZZ won't play: BAD_WAV with the walk's result, the slot as it was; a file put in the slot meanwhile: EXISTS at the end

sessions.name: no-fsinfo
sessions.about: A card without FSINFO's free count: counted a FAT sector a pass, BUSY_SCANNING until then

sessions.name: no-fsinfo-busy
sessions.about: The count still running: changing commands get BUSY_SCANNING, STATUS says the free space isn't known

sessions.name: power-cut-write
sessions.about: Power cuts in a replacing write: xfer.tmp written; the old file deleted, before the rename (the slot empty); the rename done. Each boot leaves whole files only, xfer.tmp deleted

sessions.name: power-cut-swap
sessions.about: Power cuts in a swap after each of its renames; the scan at boot puts the .swp right: undone, finished, done

sessions.name: boot-tmp
sessions.about: A temp file a power cut left is deleted at boot

sessions.name: bench
sessions.about: FRIZZ-bench.bin: HELLO, NOT_HERE to the rest
